div.head: II Eg 2.1
div.ab: Gyf hwa cyrican habbe, þe legerstow on ne sie, ðonne do he of þam nigan dælum his preoste þæt þæt he wille.
Gif hwa cyricean hæbbe, þe legerstow on ne sy, do he of þam nigon dælum his preoste þæt þæt he wille.
Si non sit ibi atrium, det ex suis IX partibus presbytero quod uult.
Gif hwa circan hæbbe þe legerstow on [ne] sy, do he of þam nigoðan dæle his preoste þæt þæt he wille.
Gyf hwa cyrican habbe þe legerstow on ne sie, ðonne do he of þam nigan dælum his preoste þæt þæt he wille.
Wenn jemand eine [Landguts-]Kirche hat, an der kein Friedhof ist, dann entrichte er [der alten Pfarre den Zehnten voll und] aus den neun [übrigen] Zehnteln seinem Priester, was er will.
If anyone has an [estate-]church at which there is no graveyard, then let him pay [the tithe in full to the old minster and] give his priest what he will from the [remaining] nine tenths.
If anyone has a church to which there is no graveyard attached, he shall pay what he will to his priest out of the next tenth part.
If anyone has a church with which there is no graveyard, he is then to pay to his priest from the [remaining] nine parts what he chooses.
If anyone has a church without a graveyard, then let him give what he chooses to his priest out of the remaining nine shares after that paid as tithe.
div.note: D omits ‘ne’ (an error, as I Cn 11 f. shows).
The Corpus text has “from the ninth part”.
